summary: Add an in-process QR renderer (ZXing core) behind a new read-only endpoint that reuses the redirect lookup.

decisions.title: ZXing core only
decisions.rationale: Core has no transitive dependencies. PNG is drawn with the JDK image API and SVG is emitted directly, so the larger javase module is not needed.

decisions.title: Reuse ShortenerService.resolve
decisions.rationale: Gives the QR endpoint the same 404 / 410 behaviour as the redirect for free, including expiry and deletion.

decisions.title: Encode the short URL
decisions.rationale: The code must survive a later change of the destination, so it points at the short link.

intendedFiles.purpose: Render PNG and SVG QR codes
Unit tests, including a decode round trip
HTTP tests for formats, sizes and error statuses

risks: Very large sizes cost memory: capped at 1024 px
A new library enters the supply chain: allowlisted group, pinned version
